verdict_sentences.en: The difference in accuracy is statistically significant: the LoRA transformer is more accurate than the TF-IDF baseline on the audited test split (McNemar p = 0.000); the macro-F1 difference is not significant (Δmacro-F1 +0.0131 (95 % CI [-0.0084, +0.0344])).
verdict_sentences.es: La diferencia de exactitud es estadísticamente significativa: el transformer con LoRA es más exacto que la línea base TF-IDF en el test auditado (McNemar p = 0.000); la diferencia de macro-F1 no es significativa (Δmacro-F1 +0.0131 (95 % CI [-0.0084, +0.0344])).
